turns.question: Which country had the lowest average daily order revenue from 17 August to 2 October 2026, counting days with no orders from that country as zero and excluding cancelled orders, and what was that average?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-daily-revenue metric, so I cannot give that average (I will not divide totals myself); the closest metric, revenue (EUR, non-cancelled orders), shows US lowest from 2026-08-17 to 2026-10-02 at 1498.25 EUR in total (next lowest FR at 1830.79 EUR), so US also has the lowest daily average over that fixed period. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
